purpose: Convert the exploratory single-run day-ahead prompt-paradigm table into an inferential comparison by repeating every paradigm/mode cell with a sampled model and reporting dispersion.

design.episode: one day-ahead planning episode: the Pricing Agent proposes 48 buy and 48 sell multipliers under the paradigm prompt, the shared optimizer solves the day-ahead schedule, and the day-ahead Evaluator accepts or requests a bounded rerun, up to the same rerun cap as the original experiment
design.inputs: the published canonical inputs (inputs/State.xlsx, inputs/Forecasted.xlsx, inputs/SpotPrices.xlsx), identical across all cells and repetitions
reporting: median, interquartile range and full range of the mode objective per cell
fraction of repetitions achieving the mode objective ordering
feasibility and, in altruistic mode, retention compliance per repetition
no ranking claim for any pair of cells whose ranges overlap
design.equivalence_convention: identical to the manuscript: differences below the day-ahead solver tolerance (4% MIP gap) are reported as equivalent

implementation_note: The original experiment ran in the archived orchestration environment. The runner must be ported per docs/E3_DA_PROMPT_REPETITION_PLAN.md before execution, and the port must be validated by reproducing the accepted FS+CoT plans structurally (same optimizer request shape) before any budgeted run.
